answer.jsFunctions: function initReview() {document.getElementById('outcome').textContent = globalThis.agoraWorkflowInput || ''; document.getElementById('continue').onclick = async function () {this.disabled=true; try {const ok=await Websandbox.connection.remote.sendPrompt({text:JSON.stringify({focus:document.getElementById('focus').value})}); if(ok===false)this.disabled=false;} catch(_){this.disabled=false;}};}
